title: Facilities and student support at AIDTM
content:
What the official website says about facilities and student support:
- Campus: the website describes a "state-of-the-art campus" and "State-of-Art Infrastructure". The campus address is Opp. Maharaj Hotel Lane, Sarkhej - Gandhinagar Highway, PO: Jamiyatpura, Gandhinagar - 382423, Gujarat.
- Classrooms: the homepage gallery highlights "Smart classroom teaching". The IT Officer provides Smart Classroom technical support and manages the institute's computer network.
- Library: the About Us page lists an Assistant Librarian (Mr. Chetas Bhagat) in the AIDTM team. No details about the library collection or timings are published.
- IBM Software Lab: the Apply page lists "IBM Software Lab - industry-aligned training" under programme highlights, without further detail.
- Learning beyond the classroom: industrial visits, industry-based capstone projects solving real-time problems, and summer internships (see the Placement page).
- Virtual tour: the website has a 360-degree Virtual Tour page (https://www.aidtm.ac.in/360tour); its content could not be read as text.
- Student support committees listed under Statutory Documents: Anti-Ragging Committee, Grievance Redressal Cell, Women Development Cell, SC/ST Cell.
- Student activities shown on the homepage: Convocation Ceremony for PGDM (BDA/TM) Batch 2022-24 (1 Mar 2025), AIDTM's Prashasti 2025 (31 Jan 2025) and Techathon 2025 (9 Jan 2025). The website menu also has Hackathon and Blogs sections.
Not found on the pages reviewed: hostel or accommodation, transport, cafeteria, sports facilities, Wi-Fi details, medical facilities. The website does not say whether these exist, so for these topics students should contact the admissions office (admissions@aidtm.ac.in).
